pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. You meet your teacher at eight o'clock in the morning. Which greeting fits best? (1 mark)
   A. Tschüss
   B. Guten Abend
   C. Guten Morgen
   D. Gute Nacht

2. What does "Hallo" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. no
   B. yes
   C. sorry, excuse me
   D. hello (friendly)

3. Which question asks "Who is that?" (1 mark)
   A. Wie ist das?
   B. Wo ist das?
   C. Wer ist das?
   D. Was ist das?

4. What does "das Fleisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. tomato
   C. orange
   D. meat

5. What does "Was isst du gern?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. When do you eat?
   B. Where do you eat?
   C. What do you like to eat?
   D. Who eats?

6. What does "das Haar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hair
   B. tooth
   C. mouth
   D. eye

7. Which two words is "Regenbogen" made from? (1 mark)
   A. Regen and Sonne
   B. Regen and Bogen
   C. Wolke and Bogen
   D. Wind and Bogen

8. What does "trinken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to sing
   B. to read
   C. to sleep
   D. to drink

9. How is the letter D named in German? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. yot
   C. kah
   D. tay

10. How is "s" pronounced before a vowel, as in "Sonne"? (1 mark)
   A. like ts
   B. like k
   C. like z
   D. like sh

11. Which word has the sound "ow" as in "cow"? (1 mark)
   A. Haus
   B. nein
   C. Tier
   D. heute

12. In the guessing game, which sentence gives the answer "It is my father"? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist mein Bruder.
   B. Das ist mein Vater.
   C. Das ist meine Oma.
   D. Das ist meine Mutter.

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Kühlschrank"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. der
   C. die
   D. das

14. What does "Wo spielt das Kind?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. When does the child play?
   B. Where does the child play?
   C. Who plays with the child?
   D. What does the child play?

15. Which little word goes with the noun "Woche"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

16. Which German word is the number 5? (1 mark)
   A. elf
   B. vierzehn
   C. fünf
   D. siebzehn

17. Which German word is the number 9? (1 mark)
   A. acht
   B. sechs
   C. dreizehn
   D. neun

18. Which food group does "die Banane" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. das Fleisch
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Gemüse

19. Which food group does "die Mango" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Obst
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Gemüse

20. Which food group does "der Tee" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Obst
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Fleisch

21. Which little word goes with the noun "Hand"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

22. What is the plural of "das Ohr"? (1 mark)
   A. die Ohrs
   B. die Ohrer
   C. die Ohren
   D. die Ohre

23. What does "deckt den Tisch" mean? (1 mark)
   A. lays the table
   B. cleans the floor
   C. opens the door
   D. cooks the food

24. What does "duschen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to cook
   B. to swim
   C. to have a shower
   D. to help

25. What does "tanzen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to have a shower
   B. to eat
   C. to dance
   D. to sing

26. What does "Uhr" mean in "sechs Uhr"? (1 mark)
   A. month
   B. day
   C. o'clock
   D. week

27. Which German word or phrase means "family"? (1 mark)
   A. der Sohn
   B. die Familie
   C. der Freund
   D. der Onkel

28. Which form completes "Sie (she) ___ zwei Schwestern"? (1 mark)
   A. habe
   B. hast
   C. hat
   D. haben

29. Which German word means "strong"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. alt
   B. fleißig
   C. stark
   D. klein

30. What is the plural of "die Tür"? (1 mark)
   A. die Türen
   B. die Türs
   C. die Türe
   D. die Türer

31. What does "der sechste" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. first
   B. fourth
   C. seventh
   D. sixth

32. What does "Juni" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. March
   C. April
   D. February

33. Which German word or phrase means "sugar"? (1 mark)
   A. der Zucker
   B. die Kartoffel
   C. der Saft
   D. der Kohl

34. Which little word goes with the noun "Mais"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

35. Which German word or phrase means "supper"? (1 mark)
   A. der Käse
   B. der Mais
   C. das Abendessen
   D. die Tomate

36. Which German word or phrase means "mouth"? (1 mark)
   A. der Bauch
   B. das Haar
   C. der Zeh
   D. der Mund

37. Which word has a silent h that makes the vowel long? (1 mark)
   A. Zahn
   B. Mund
   C. Bauch
   D. Kopf

38. Which plural has an umlaut? (1 mark)
   A. die Beine
   B. die Augen
   C. die Ohren
   D. die Füße

39. What does "heiß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cold
   B. hot
   C. dry
   D. windy

40. What does "hinter der Tür" mean? (1 mark)
   A. on the door
   B. behind the door
   C. next to the door
   D. in front of the door

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in German what you do on Saturday. Start with "Am Samstag". (2 marks)

42. Write these numbers in German: 1, 15, 20. (3 marks)

43. Write a sentence about your favourite room in German. (2 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: pot, face, father, grandmother. (4 marks)

45. Match the body part to what it does: Auge, Ohr, Nase. (3 marks)

46. Make a playful food blend from Mango and Milch, and say what it is. (2 marks)

47. Write three sentences about the weather in German. (3 marks)

48. Explain the trick to decide between ie and ei when you write. (2 marks)

49. Read: "Er hat schwarze Haare und braune Augen." Say what it means. (2 marks)

50. Write the German names of these months: April, May, June. (3 marks)

51. Name the three umlaut letters and the special letter ß. (2 marks)

52. Write in German: "Who is that? That is my mother." (2 marks)

53. Explain why a menu uses a colon after the meal name. (2 marks)

54. Write the plural of Fuß, Zahn and Auge. (3 marks)

55. Write three sentences in German about your father or mother: name, age and one adjective. (3 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bedroom, chair, window, watermelon. (4 marks)

57. Say why the word "Schlafzimmer" is a das word. (2 marks)

58. Read aloud and write the sound of these words: Schule, heute, Haus, Tür. (4 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: toe, song, juice, egg, water. (5 marks)

60. Write these numbers in German: 5, 8, 13. (3 marks)

61. Read: "Kamau hat Geburtstag. Er ist zehn Jahre alt." Say in English who has a birthday and how old he is. (2 marks)

62. Say why all nouns in a German text begin with capital letters and how this helps a reader. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Guten Morgen
   Morgen means morning, so Guten Morgen is the greeting for the morning.

2. D — hello (friendly)
   Hallo means hello (friendly).

3. C — Wer ist das?
   Wer means who.

4. D — meat
   das Fleisch means meat.

5. C — What do you like to eat?
   was = what, isst = eat, gern = with pleasure.

6. A — hair
   das Haar means hair.

7. B — Regen and Bogen
   Regen = rain and Bogen = arch or bow: a rainbow.

8. D — to drink
   trinken means to drink.

9. A — day
   In German the letter D is called day.

10. C — like z
   S before a vowel sounds like z.

11. A — Haus
   The letters au sound like ow.

12. B — Das ist mein Vater.
   Vater means father.

13. B — der
   It is der Kühlschrank, so the little word is der.

14. B — Where does the child play?
   wo means where.

15. A — die
   It is die Woche, so the little word is die.

16. C — fünf
   5 in German is fünf.

17. D — neun
   9 in German is neun.

18. A — das Obst
   die Banane belongs to das Obst.

19. B — das Obst
   die Mango belongs to das Obst.

20. A — die Getränke
   der Tee belongs to die Getränke.

21. B — die
   It is die Hand, so the little word is die.

22. C — die Ohren
   The plural of das Ohr is die Ohren.

23. A — lays the table
   den Tisch decken means to lay the table.

24. C — to have a shower
   duschen means to have a shower.

25. C — to dance
   tanzen means to dance.

26. C — o'clock
   sechs Uhr is six o'clock.

27. B — die Familie
   family in German is die Familie.

28. C — hat
   sie (she) goes with hat.

29. C — stark
   strong in German is stark.

30. A — die Türen
   The plural of die Tür is die Türen.

31. D — sixth
   der sechste means sixth.

32. A — June
   Juni means June.

33. A — der Zucker
   sugar in German is der Zucker.

34. B — der
   It is der Mais, so the little word is der.

35. C — das Abendessen
   supper in German is das Abendessen.

36. D — der Mund
   mouth in German is der Mund.

37. A — Zahn
   Zahn has a silent h after the a.

38. D — die Füße
   Fuß becomes Füße.

39. B — hot
   heiß means hot.

40. B — behind the door
   hinter means behind.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Am Samstag, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: eins, fünfzehn, zwanzig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mein Lieblingszimmer ist die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Topf, das Gesicht, der Vater, die Oma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Auge = sehen, Ohr = hören, Nase = riechen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mangmil, a mango and milk drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible blend, 1 mark for the explanation.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: If you hear ee, write ie; if you hear eye, write ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: He has black hair and brown eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hair, 1 mark for eyes.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: April, Mai, Juni.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: ä, ö, ü and ß (Eszett).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three umlauts and 1 mark for ß.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wer ist das? Das ist meine Mutter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces the list of food that follows.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for announces the list and 1 mark for an example.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Füße, die Zähne, die Augen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct plural.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist 35 Jahre alt. Sie ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Schlafzimmer, der Stuhl, das Fenster, die Wassermelone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Its last part, Zimmer, is a das word, and a joined word takes the article of the last part.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for last part, 1 mark for Zimmer being das.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: Schule = SHOO-le, heute = HOY-te, Haus = house (ow), Tür = tür (ee with round lips).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word.

59. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Zeh, das Lied, der Saft, das Ei, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: fünf, acht, dreizehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kamau has a birthday and he is ten years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a spelling rule. Readers can spot the nouns quickly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the help.
